name: jarvis-ai
description: JARVIS AI — Shaxsiy Intellektual Yordamchi (Futuristik 3D, Ikki Qo'l Imo-Ishoralari, O'zbek Ovozli Yordamchi, Windows Agent va Supabase)

scripts.start: concurrently -k -n "AGENT,BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "magenta,blue,cyan" "python -m uvicorn agent.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8001 --app-dir windows-agent" "python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload --app-dir backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && python -m pip install -r backend/requirements.txt && python -m pip install -r windows-agent/requirements.txt
